name: PREVIOUSLY IN GTM
tagline: A weekly read for founders, GTM leaders and growth marketers.
title: Before you add another GTM tool, write its quit rule
standfirst: A long read on why the GTM stack keeps growing, why almost nobody can prove any one piece of it is working, and the one discipline brand marketing already built that tooling hasn't borrowed yet.
cover_sub: Why almost nobody can prove any one piece of the GTM stack is working.

insight.label: By the numbers
insight.text: the true accuracy figure one vendor published for its own top scoring band, the only such number any intent data vendor has shown.
insight.source: Source: GTM Tool Time, citing a Demandbase blog post on its Pipeline Predict model. Single customer, single source.

quote.label: Worth pinning above your desk
quote.text: You know it when you see it in the data.
quote.attribution: Kelly Megel, fractional CMO, via Cannonball GTM

framework.title: Four things every quit rule needs
framework.subtitle: Write all four before you sign.
framework.footer: No number means no quit rule, whatever the deck promises.

items.name: Metric
items.question: What number proves it is working?
items.example: A measured hit rate or lift, not a volume claim.

items.name: Deadline
items.question: By when do you expect to see it?
items.example: A date on the calendar, not a future renewal.

items.name: Owner
items.question: Who checks, and who can call it?
items.example: One named person, not a committee.

items.name: Control
items.question: What group never got the tool?
items.example: A held out team, segment or list to compare against.
